root_cause.1_profile_add_group_confirmation: Success/error Alerts lived inside the addableGroups.length>0 gate; inviteByNpub awaits reloadGroups, so the invitee becomes a pending member and the whole block unmounts in the same render that sets success.
root_cause.2_create_group_before_ready: create-group-btn was gated only on !unsupported; MarmotContext.createGroup returns null while clientRef is unset (before ready), surfacing a generic create-group-error.
root_cause.3_blocked_unread: initDirectMessageCounts filtered pending contacts only; archived (blocked, legacy-hidden with kept history) peers were scanned and counted, and their chat cannot be opened to mark read.
root_cause.4_foreign_invite_expiry: inviteExpiries was derived from every stored link's groupId and re-derived every 60s by the sweep; a groupId absent from the groups list (backup-restore residue) fed groupsDomainTotal with no card to clear it.
root_cause.5_decodecard_name_len_0: decodeCard checked only nameLen > 32; a validly self-signed name_len=0 card (never emitted by either encoder) decoded to nickname '' (LWW clobber path).
root_cause.6_call_block_gate: Incoming-call authorization used bare isAllowedDmSender; block keeps the peer in knownPeers, so a blocked peer could ring a direct 1:1 call.

fix.1: Exported pure addToGroupView(); confirmation Alerts render outside the picker gate (showStatus), picker keeps its own gate (showPicker).
fix.2: create-group-btn isDisabled={!ready}; CreateGroupModal submit disabled and handleSubmit no-ops while !ready.
fix.3: initDirectMessageCounts skips archived contacts and drops their in-memory counters after the scan (dropDirectMessageCounters); history and last-read timestamps untouched; idempotent.
fix.4: unreadStore.scopeInviteExpiriesToGroups(ids) (called in MarmotContext.reloadGroups after loadAllGroups resolves) prunes absent-group counters; initInviteExpiries/incrementInviteExpiry honour the scope; scope is null (no pruning) until the first loaded list; link records never touched.
fix.5: decodeCard rejects signed v1/v2 cards with name_len=0 ('contactCard: signed card must carry a non-empty name').
fix.6: CallManager.isBlockedCaller dep: an offer from a blocked caller that binds to no group (direct 1:1) is dropped silently before the busy auto-reject; IncomingCallWatcher wires it to isBlockedPeer over a live loadBlockedPeers ref (refreshed on blockedPeersRevision). Group calls untouched (Q8).

retrospective.harder_than_needed: The brief's non-relay e2e command omits the flock, but every run-e2e invocation starts `next dev` against the shared app/.next; my first non-relay run collided with the parallel diagnosis agent's locked relay run and 10/10 failed with dev-server 404s/JSON errors (and may have perturbed that agent's run). Re-running under the same flock gave 10/10. Also the brief asked for a property test but the repo has no fast-check (hand-rolled seeded sweep used).
retrospective.surprised_by: inviteExpiries is re-derived every 60s from persisted links, so an in-memory prune 'on groups-list load' alone would be undone by the next sweep; the fix needed a persistent group scope honoured by the derive and the live bump.

Targeted vitest 30 files/432 green, tsc clean, groups-direct-invite-lifecycle 7/7 on a wiped relay under the e2e lock.
